mdRunbook.ai.provider.markdownDescription: Where **Explain Output**, **Suggest Next Steps** and **Summarize Incident** send the (redacted) runbook. `off` (default) never sends anything and hides the AI buttons. Can only be set in user settings, so a workspace cannot change it.

mdRunbook.ai.confirmBeforeSend.markdownDescription: Ask before sending, showing the provider, model, size and whether names are pseudonymized, with **Preview** of the exact text. Can only be set in user settings, so a workspace cannot change it.

mdRunbook.ai.confirmOncePerSession.markdownDescription: With `mdRunbook.ai.confirmBeforeSend`, ask only once per provider and VS Code session instead of before every send. Can only be set in user settings, so a workspace cannot change it.

mdRunbook.ai.pseudonymize.markdownDescription: Replace hostnames, IPs, URLs, emails and similar names with stable aliases before sending; aliases in the answer are mapped back locally. Can only be set in user settings, so a workspace cannot change it.

mdRunbook.ai.vscodeModel.markdownDescription: Preferred VS Code language model: an id, `vendor/family`, or part of the family or name. Empty = a Copilot Claude model, else any Copilot model, else any available model. Can only be set in user settings, so a workspace cannot change it.

mdRunbook.ai.anthropicModel.markdownDescription: Claude model for the `anthropic` provider. Can only be set in user settings, so a workspace cannot change it.

mdRunbook.ai.anthropicBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the Claude API, or of a gateway or proxy that speaks the same API. `HTTPS_PROXY` is not used; point this at a reachable gateway instead. Can only be set in user settings, so a workspace cannot change it.

mdRunbook.ai.maxTokens.markdownDescription: Maximum length of an answer from the `anthropic` provider, in tokens (includes the model's thinking).

mdRunbook.ai.maxProposals.markdownDescription: Maximum number of proposed cells **Suggest Next Steps** inserts.

mdRunbook.ai.proposerName.markdownDescription: Written as `by=` in the fence of proposed cells, e.g. `bash proposed by=ai reason="…"`.
